4 Check voltage between terminal ODMS of ECM and body ground.
PREPARATION:
Turn the ignition switch ON.
CHECK:
Check voltage between terminal ODMS of ECM and body
ground when 0/D main switch is ON and OFF.
OK:
0/D main switch Specified voltage
Preas continuously 0/0 main switch Below 1.0 V
N Release O/D main switch 10-14 V
Check and replace the ECM (See page IN-20). B
5 Check voltage between terminal ODLP of ECM and body ground.
PREPARATION:
ODLP (a) Disconnect the connector of ECM.
(b) Turn the ignition switch ON.
CHECK:
Check voltage between terminal ODLP of ECM and body
ground.
OK:
Voltage: 7.5 -14 V
N
Check and replace the ECM (See page IN-20). B
Check and replace harness and connector between combination meter and ECM, 0/0 main
switch and ECM, O/D main switch and body ground (See page IN-20).
